profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
I have experience in Microsoft .Net programming and since I have experience in both front end and back end web development, I would currently call myself a full stack developer.

Specialties: In terms of a computer programming specialty I prefer graphics and user interface design, and can do custom logos, 3D designs and infographics.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Helped out with the Annual Conference 2015 pages and Joomla to WordPress conversion
and afterwards did some minor computer consulting.

positions.title: Owner / Manager / Small Businessman / Entrepreneur
positions.description: Ran my own retail store selling computer supplies and accessories. Provided computer design/printing to various small businesses around Lake County in Northern California. Also set up custom Point-of-Sale networks and developed specialized database software for inventory control and management.

honors.title: Larry Hamilton/Hewlett Packard Excellence in Programming Award
honors.description: Won award for best ,Net programming project, an ad-hoc student scheduling app with graphic printout.

volunteerExperiences.description: I assist with FreeGeek with their mission to to recycle technology, promote Linux, and provide computers for schools and non-profit organizations.
